Every NBA Team Ranked by their Shooting Ability

Who are the best shooting teams in the NBA? We have created a minutes-weighted shooting rating for each team. Think of it as the shooting ability (out of 100) for the team for each of their players.

*Shooting Quality

A measure of shooting quality that takes into account both attempts as well as accuracy and scaled from 1-100.

((Spacing x 2) + ((Standardized Padded FT% + Standardized Padded 3P%) x 5)) / 7 2 parts spacing + 5 parts padding shooting percentages, blended 75/25 with a player's career spacing rating, converted to a 1-100 point scale. *Spacing = (3PA * (((3P%*1.5) * 1.5) - 0.535))
